rows.label: STR
rows.note: Strength: power with STR weapons, +2 max HP per point, +1 armor per 4 points; unarmed hits use STR + DEX.

rows.label: DEX
rows.note: Dexterity: initiative (8 + DEX - gear burden) and move rate, power with DEX weapons and of shots without a ranged weapon.

rows.label: INT
rows.note: Intelligence: debuff resistance (2.5% per point) and power with INT weapons.

rows.label: PERC
rows.note: Perception: crit chance +1% per point above 10; at 18 or more, ranged weapons reach 1 tile further.

rows.label: KNOW
rows.note: Knowledge: from 12, every 4 points open skill families one level earlier (up to 2 levels).

rows.label: Initiative
rows.note: Initiative: 8 + DEX - the burden of worn gear and carry overload (at least 1); units with more act earlier.

rows.label: Tiles per move
rows.note: Tiles one move covers (move rate): (8 + DEX + 2) / 5, from 1 to 4; burden and overload lower it only past initiative 1; haste adds 1, slow takes 1.

rows.label: Crit %
rows.note: Critical hit chance: 5% + 1% per PERC above 10, plus the weapon proficiency bonus.

rows.label: Melee power
rows.note: Melee hit power: the weapon's power (with tier and proficiency bonuses) + its scaling stat x your proficiency scaling.

rows.label: Ranged power
rows.note: Ranged hit power, the same way with a ranged weapon; without one, DEX alone.

rows.label: Armor
rows.note: Armor rating: gear mitigation + STR / 4; it cuts damage taken by rating / (rating + 50).

rows.label: Debuff resist %
rows.note: Chance to shake off a debuff: 2.5% per INT, plus the unit's own resistances.

rows.label: AP
rows.note: Action points: the most this unit holds; each round refills some or all of it (the battle's AP regen). A skill costs its level (1-5) in AP, Move 1 and Rest nothing, or the AP cost its row sets under the AP cost rule.

innate.text: Innate passives (no slot): Warden's Eye, Keen Senses
